The '''Pumpkin Mask''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be [[Tailoring#Hats|tailored]] using [[Cloth]] and a [[Jack-O-Lantern]] at the sewing machine inside [[2 Willow Lane|Emily's house]] or the [[Sewing Machine]] received as a reward for the [[Quests#Rock Rejuvenation|"Rock Rejuvenation"]] special order.
